findings.description: perturb() orientation np.where(det<0,-1,1) is int64, promoting product with Float32 gradient to Float64. Both-pose runtime dtype probe confirms shading normal, weights, triCoarse/triFine, variation, palette and P are Float64; p,n,height,envelope,UV,tex are Float32. This contradicts any interpretation that the whole P replay is strict Float32. Noise/hash calls themselves cast to Float32.
findings.action: Future deterministic correction should explicitly type orientation branches as np.float32 and audit every operation dtype; do not fit outputs. Existing result remains nominal and unqualified.

findings.description: CPU recursive 2x2 RGBA8 box-average with floor(mean+.5) is a chosen mip model. Source calls gl.generateMipmap; source does not prescribe this rounding. Bilinear interpolation CPU fractions also promote to double before final Float32 cast. Max Euclidean gradient LOD is a model, not measured hardware LOD.
findings.action: Parent investigating generated-mip arithmetic; no alternative tuned here.

findings.description: Visible same-quad neighbors may not match helper lanes for another primitive. PNG dimensions529x980 mean Y reversal preserves even quad membership. dy sign reversal alone is harmless: both determinant and gradient reverse, preserving sign(det)*gradient; fwidth and LOD norms use absolute values. Odd last-column derivative fallback does not touch selected columns128..400.

Nominal normal generation flips all negative-Y normals, whereas source flips only exact FAR_LAND or specified back-facing primitive62002. Selected domain is ordinary terrain/far with parent association evidence; generic extrapolation is invalid. Captured slopeResponse agrees exactly, but this is not a general normal certification.

CPU omits geologicalEarthRock palette/texture branches, treats coastal factors as saturated1, skips zero-horizontal inverse-projection branch, and uses1e-30 rather than source1e-5 normal/triweight degeneracy clamps. These do not activate for the established selected ordinary-soil domain with coast>595m, nonzero normals and distant horizontal coordinates. Source lighting and posttexture relief changes occur after palette output and do not change pre-identity incoming P.

Full-P script loads verified capture image hashes but does not itself enforce renderer/soil/normal source hashes at startup (soil hash is reported). Standalone reproduction depends on earlier source-check and parent normal provenance. No actual mismatch observed in this audit.

textureSetup.source: woodland-clearing assets order leaf,bark,soil. Soil index2 uses texStorage2D9levels RGBA8, DOM Image upload, generateMipmap, LINEAR_MIPMAP_LINEAR min, LINEAR mag, REPEAT axes. Renderer has no UNPACK_FLIP_Y_WEBGL, UNPACK_PREMULTIPLY_ALPHA_WEBGL or UNPACK_COLORSPACE_CONVERSION_WEBGL changes.
textureSetup.decodeAssessment: No ICC/gamma/sRGB metadata and all pixels opaque: asset provides no evidence for tagged-color conversion or alpha-premultiplication mismatch. Default DOM image upload versus Pillow remains a platform boundary, not identified error.
